03:29 - Dirty Read Problem
06:24 - Non-Repeatable Read Problem

14:44 - READ_UNCOMMITTED Isolation level
17:39 - READ_COMMITTED Isolation level
24:50 - REPEATABLE_READ Isolation level
31:26 - SERIALIZABLE Isolation level
